# LUD-03

## Summary

LNURL-channel specification. Channel management via Lightning wallets.

`author: fiatjaf`

[LUD-0](0.md)
[LUD-1](1.md)

## Specification

LNURL-channel allows service providers to let users open Lightning channels via QR codes.
The flow:

1. Service provider displays LNURL-channel QR
2. User scans with wallet
3. Wallet fetches the LNURL endpoint
4. Server returns channel request details
5. User confirms and opens channel

## Use Cases

- Lightning service providers
- Routing node operators
- Channel management automation
